body:
It should be as standalone easy to download as single file with `curl <github link> | bash`, and also as integrated to hive-mind package.

So it should be available in the root docker image of Hive Mind out of the box, and also in any place outside Hive Mind docker - it may be on server, near, to make local deployment, it may be on developer machine to make remote deployment to SSH via any layers of intermediate ssh servers, proxies, VPNs and so on.

So we should have single place where we can fully configure and manage our Hive Mind instance deployment.

```
 "hive-cleanup": "./src/cleanup.mjs",
    "configure-claude": "./src/configure-claude.mjs",
    "hive-screens": "./src/hive-screens.mjs",
    "hive-models": "./src/hive-models.mjs",
```

These should go to `hive-manager`, it also should simplify everything we have in docs (executable separately, and as deploy bundled sub-command).

If `    "close-linked-issues": "./src/close-linked-issues.mjs"` is used inside system like in solve/hive or telegram bot - ok, we can keep it saperate if that something for maintenance we should remove it and integrate inside single `hive-manager` command/tool/script.

We should take all the best practices from https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind-control-center, https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind-control-center/tree/main/src so all maintenance actions will be integrated in unified `hive-manager` command, so we have all useful tools at one places, so it will be easy to maintain our system, debug and so on.

So as the result most of code at https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind-control-center will be gone, ideally the entire need for the repository at all.

We need to collect data related about the issue to this repository, make sure we compile that data to `./docs/case-studies/issue-{id}` folder, and use it to do deep case study analysis (also make sure to search online for additional facts and data), list of each and all requirements from the issue, and propose possible solutions and solution plans for each requirement (we should also check known existing components/libraries, that solve similar problem or can help in solutions).

Please plan and execute everything in this single pull request, you have unlimited time and context, as context auto-compacts and you can continue indefinitely, until each and every requirement fully addressed, and everything is totally done.
title: Make unified hive-manager tool
